conbody.p: The instrument cluster displays the speed limit information.

li.p: When the Advanced Assist is equipped, the upcoming speed limit and remaining distance on the road are displayed.
When the navigation is applied, the display appears if “Auto Assist,” “Manual Assist,” or “Warning” is selected.
When the navigation is not applied, the display appears if “Speed Limit Assist” or “Speed Limit Warning” is selected.
If Intelligent Speed Limit Assist cannot recognize speed limit information from the road, the instrument cluster displays the ‘---’ sign.
Intelligent Speed Limit Assist provides other road sign information in addition to the posted speed limit. The additional road sign information provided may vary according to your region.

The supplementary information displayed below the speed limit sign on the cluster indicates the conditions under which the sign applies. If the supplementary road sign information cannot be determined, a blank space is shown on the cluster.
The images or colors may display differently depending on the specifications of the instrument cluster or theme.
